messages:
nina: That parrot mascot reveal was everything. stolen my heart and my sandwich. :parrot: :sandwich:
jared: I came for the roadmap, stayed for the feathered sax solo. anyone got a clip?
tanya: Clip incoming in 5 — need to trim my commentary out (unfiltered laugh track)
ops-bot: Auto-upload complete: https://redwood.company/all-hands/2473301234/clip.mp4
marco: :rofl: the parrot tried to moderate the Q&A. bold leadership moves.
gina: Can we make the parrot an emoji? also need votes: :parrot: for mascot, :penguin: for mascot alternate
jared: :parrot: (but only if it can approve my PRs)
tanya: :parrot: +1, but who designs a mascot with better CI skills than me
marco: Snack report: who wants mini empanadas in the kitchen tomorrow? react :empanada: or :no_entry_sign:
gina: :empanada: from gina. will bring napkins. maybe plates?
nina: I will bring the napkins, jared brings the napkins of shame (you know the ones)
jared: i will supply shame. can someone restock the decaf? my plants are judging me. :seedling:
ops-bot: Note created in ops inbox: "restock decaf, gluten-free cookies"
support-bot: Helpful doc: https://redwood.company/handbook/culture#mascots (see "mascot etiquette")
tanya: low-stakes poll: afterparty in #random? yes/no. say "party" or "naw"
marco: party
gina: party! i'll bring the pun generator
jared: naw (i have a dentist appointment)
nina: party, and someone please archive the best one-liners into the Slack slack-of-fame thread
tanya: doing that now. saving: "latency is a mood" and "can't spell cache without cake"
marco: also logistics: office plants committee needs volunteers to water the cactus. who?
gina: i'll take Wednesdays
jared: i'll alternate with gina. cactus needs themed playlists. :cactus: :musical_score:
ops-bot: Reminder set: office-plant rota updated. thanks folks! :white_check_mark: 
nina: Love the energy — best spontaneous all-hands vibes. see y'all in #random for the parrot afterparty :tada:
